verdict.rationale: Plausible does support API keys, and docs state keys are scoped to one team (determining which sites they can query), providing a basic form of credential scoping. However, there's no evidence of finer-grained least-privilege controls (e.g., read-only vs write scopes, per-site restriction beyond team, expiring/revocable agent-specific tokens) or any agent-oriented credential-issuance workflow. Missing for 10: granular permission scopes, per-site/action-level restriction beyond team, agent-specific credential issuance flow, OAuth-style scoped tokens.
